subcommands.name: wire
subcommands.description: Install Makaio hooks into a client's native config

args.name: scope
args.description: Scope at which to install hooks (e.g. user, global)

args.name: projectDir
args.description: Absolute path to the project directory (required for project/local scopes)

subcommands.name: unwire
subcommands.description: Remove Makaio hooks from a client's native config

args.name: scope
args.description: Scope from which to remove hooks (e.g. user, global)

args.name: projectDir
args.description: Absolute path to the project directory (required for project/local scopes)

subcommands.name: wiring
subcommands.description: Show hook wiring status for all or a specific client

args.name: client
args.description: Optional client identifier to filter results

args.name: projectDir
args.description: Absolute path to the project directory

subcommands.name: profile-list
subcommands.description: List all profiles for a client

subcommands.name: profile-create
subcommands.description: Create a named profile config directory

subcommands.name: profile-delete
subcommands.description: Delete a named profile and its config directory

subcommands.name: profile-default
subcommands.description: Set the default profile for a client

subcommands.name: profile-show
subcommands.description: Show profile details and config directory

subcommands.name: profile-open
subcommands.description: Open a profile config directory in the OS file manager
